scope: Assistance draft only; not a bank claim or submission. Actual 9M2026 plus modeled Q4, then annual scenarios.

capital.reason: Assumed RWA density, not reported prudential denominator. Initial capital proxy = actual Sep26 CAR × assumed RWA. RWA scales with noncash asset pool. 65% total-asset RWA plus 10% starting numerator haircut sensitivity. Actual FY25/26 RWA pending source pack.

liquidity.reason: Sep26 mandatory reserves 3264.904 / combined cash 9193.018 = 35.516%; use rounded 35.5% as proxy, stress 20% lower. Mandatory reserve is not verified eligible reserve and combined cash is not all yield-bearing. Cash yield pool assumes 40% combined cash earning; not an actual product split. Actual Sep26 mandatory reserve / (20% headline CRR × customer deposits) implies 77.0553% illustrative reserve base; neither this denominator nor cash eligibility is verified. Main payout screen uses this calibrated proxy, and full-deposit basis remains a conservative gap/payout sensitivity. Source reports no statutory liquidity breaches; prior all-deposit screen was not actual compliance.

rate.reason: Calibrate separate deposit/wholesale rates from observed 9M26 blended funding expense and average balances, assumed 1.7× wholesale rate, not observed contractual pricing. Annual rates drift from FY26 annual macro averages; Q4 uses observed 9M runrate with scenario multipliers to avoid timing mismatch. Asset pool includes net loans, securities, placements, trading/pledged securities and 40% cash; blended yield, no double count or claim observed note yield.

tax.reason: 9M26 effective tax 545.655/1530.986=35.64%; FY25 35.73%. No tax credit for losses. Historical actual includes levies, no assumed statutory bases.

notes: Original bank-only source pack by Codex retained unchanged. No actual missing loan gross/ECL/Tier1, no forecast gross/NPL ratio, no claim of compliance.

Trading and pledged assets already inside other_assets, x_ memo only; modeled securities included in income pool separately but never double-counted in balance sheet. No explicit FX P&L without net currency position. Q3 FX effects on cash not projected as income.

Q4 statutory reserve allocation 12.5% of positive full-year PAT less actual YTD123.167m, later annual tiers using opening statutory reserve / paid-up capital. No Q4 dividend assumed; actual YTD1115m preserved. Future dividends conditional on positive PAT and retained earnings, CAR buffer and cash eligibility screen; not permission or actual guidance.

No new equity capital, no future OCI. Existing credit risk reserve held constant because gross credit migration unknown; sensitivity caveat. Regulatory minimum and reserve rate from macro; any gap flags not plugged by fresh funding.
Net lending credit cost proxy; FY22 DDEP impairment not extrapolated. Q3 other regulatory sanctions and post-balance-sheet penalty disclosed by source pack; no assumed timing.

penalty.reason: Issuer Q3 disclosed post-balance-sheet confirmed penalty GHS16.1m; baseline excludes an additional separately modeled charge to avoid double count, stress treats it as extra Q4 pretax expense with no incremental tax benefit, not a claim of actual recognition or deductibility.
